name: Hong Jie
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2016-2026)
forbes_bio: Hong Jie is the chairman and CEO of SKSHU Paint, a supplier of coatings known for its 3Trees brand.
Founded in 2002, the Putian, Fujian-based company went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2016.
SKSHU Paint has almost 10,000 employees.

name: Brian Higgins
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Brian Higgins is the cofounder of King Street Capital Management, a distressed-debt focused hedge fund.
He started King Street in 1995 with fellow billionaire O. Francis Biondi, whom he met on First Boston's high-yield desk in the late 1980's.
King Street Capital Management managed over $25 billion of assets in 2023.
forbes_facts: He and cofounder Francis Biondi manage the King Street Charitable Trust, which donates to medical research and Villanova, Higgins' alma mater, among others.
Higgins and Biondi are known for shying away from publicity and don't hold investor days, during which investors meet the firm's asset managers.

name: Will Adderley
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2020-2023); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: Will Adderley is the son of Bill and Jean Adderley, the founders of UK home furnishings retailer Dunelm.
The business was founded after the couple set up a market stall in Leicester, U.K. in 1979.
They took the company public on the London Stock Exchange in 2006.
The Adderleys own 43% of the business and Will serves as the company's deputy chairman.
There are now almost 200 Dunelm stores across the U.K.

name: Alexander Diehl
forbes_bio: Alexander Diehl is a member of the fourth generation of the Diehl family, which maintains 100% ownership of the Diehl Group.
The Nuremberg, Germany, based family enterprise is a global technology leader, generating annual sales of more than $5 billion.
The group's diversified portfolio includes strategic sectors such as Metall, Controls, Defence, Aviation, and Hydrometering.
The Diehl Group employs a workforce of more than 18,000 people across its various international divisions.
Originally founded in 1902 as a specialised foundry, the company has evolved over four generations into a major international industrial group.

name: Susan Co
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2020); Forbes annual (2013-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Susan Co is the chairman of Puregold Price Club, a chain of hypermarkets and supermarkets she cofounded with her husband Lucio in 1998.
Starting with a location in Mandaluyong City, the chain now boasts nearly 800 stores across the Philippines.
Their son, Ferdinand Vincent, helps them run the company as president.
The Cos also head listed Cosco Capital, which has stakes in liquor distribution and real estate businesses.

name: Tiger Woods
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2023-2026)
forbes_bio: Tiger Woods has earned nearly $2 billion (pretax) in his pro golf career, including a PGA Tour-record $121 million in prize money. In 2022, Forbes certified him as a billionaire, making him only the second active athlete ever with that distinction, after LeBron James.

Woods reached that rarefied air despite reportedly turning down a "mind-blowingly enormous" offer from the upstart LIV Golf tour, a deal that then-LIV CEO Greg Norman told the Washington Post would have been in the "high nine digits."
Woods has parlayed his golfing paychecks into investments that include two homes on Jupiter Island, a golf-course design business and high-end mini-golf chain Popstroke.
Woods and fellow golf star Rory McIlroy announced in 2022 that they had founded TMRW Sports, a tech-focused venture that launched a new golf league called TGL in 2025.
The superstar is also a partner with Justin Timberlake and British billionaire Joe Lewis in Nexxus, a luxury real-estate venture.

name: Ulrike Meister
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Ulrike Meister is one of four family heirs who inherited 63% of kitchen appliance manufacturer Rational AG.
Siegfried Meister founded the company in 1973 and died in 2017, at age 78. Its products include ovens, steamers and grills.
Rational has more than a 50% share of the global market for multifunctional food preparation appliances used in large-scale and commercial kitchens.
The company, which went public in 2000, has grown consistently without acquisitions, and prides itself on innovative, energy-efficient technology.
forbes_facts: Siegfried Meister had the idea to cook using steam after disliking how food was prepared at restaurant chain Wienerwald, where he worked previously.
Rational employs over 250 professional chefs, and its products are used in the White House and Buckingham Palace.

name: Nanu Gupta
forbes_bio: Nanu Gupta is the founder and chairman of retailer Vijay Sales, which sells a range of electronics and appliances including televisions, air conditioners and refrigerators across 160 stores in India.
Gupta started out in 1967 with a small store selling sewing machines and radios in a Mumbai suburb.
Vijay Sales started selling black and white TVs in 1972 and color TVs in 1982.
His sons Nilesh and Ashish as well as his grandson Karan are directors on the company's board.
forbes_facts: Gupta started his career as a distributor for sewing machine company Usha International.
